snippet.title: Micro Stream RPG Introduction Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Micro Stream RPG, a tiny, auto-play RPG for Twitch streamers! Let your viewers go on their own RPG adventure, fight enemies, defeat bosses, and level up, all handled for you!

Find the game here on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809670/Micro_Stream_RPG/
